Geometry Dash

Geometry Dash Lite is a free, rhythm-based action platformer developed by RobTop Games and released on August 13, 2013. Players control an auto-moving geometric icon using a single-tap jump mechanism synced to electronic music, aiming to clear obstacles without crashing. 
Gameplay and Features
One-Touch Control: Jump, fly, and flip gravity by tapping the screen or clicking to the beat of EDM, techno, and dubstep soundtracks.
Instant Resets: Crashing into a spike, wall, or pit resets the level to 0% progress immediately.
Practice Mode: Place custom checkpoints to train through difficult sections of a stage.
Character Customization: Unlock and change icons, colors, and vehicle shapes using collected orbs and coins.

Lite vs. Full Version
Free Access: Contains a limited set of official levels (up to 19–21 levels including recent updates like Fingerdash and Deadlocked) compared to the paid version.
No Level Editor: Lacks community level creation tools and online level searching found in the complete game.
Ads: The mobile and browser variants are ad-supported.
